Make your music dreams possible

Get what you need — from instruments to sound equipment and more — and start playing today with the Synchrony Music & Sound credit card.*

 

Synchrony partners with top music brands and stores to bring you a way to pay with convenient monthly payments and exclusive offers. See if you prequalify with no impact to your credit score and find a location that accepts the card below!

 

The Synchrony Music & Sound credit card is not accepted at all music retailers included in the locator. Ask yours for details.

Music & Sound credit card FAQs

Have questions? We have answers.

Access our contact information here.

Alerts are one-way communications via email or text message about your account. Log in now and set up alerts to stay on top of your account and to track your daily spending.

If you received your card with a sticker on the front of it, you will need to call the number listed on the sticker to verify your information and activate your account.

With Autopay, you can have your payment automatically deduct from your bank account each month on your payment due date. The payment will be the amount you select: either the Statement Balance, the Total Minimum Payment Due or a self-selected (other) amount.
